title: Resend closing call
description: A centred two-line display-serif title lit white to half-white and a graphite button with a chevron; on desktop a giant, barely-there wordmark spans the page width beneath it, cropped by the band's bottom edge, and fades in as it scrolls into view.
notes: the wordmark is SVG text stretched to the page width (desktop only); its fade is a CSS view() timeline
the title reads --resend-serif from the resend theme, falling back to the display face elsewhere
